en_title: Microsoft Announces Xbox Nano Controller, a Tiny New Gamepad That Fits in Your Pocket
cn_title: 微软发布迷你XBOX Nano手柄
subtitle: 装进口袋，随身带走
opus_summary: 微软公布XBOX Nano手柄，体积更小、更轻，支持XBOX无线连接与蓝牙，11月发售，现已开放预购。微软还计划与三星及Meta合作，推出附带手柄和订阅的套餐。

paragraphs.en: Xbox controllers are already the default option for a whole range of devices, from the Xbox itself to gaming PCs and tablets. But Microsoft has just announced the Nano Controller, a smaller and cheaper Xbox controller.
paragraphs.cn: 从XBOX主机到游戏PC和平板电脑，XBOX手柄早已成为众多设备的默认选择。不过，微软刚刚公布了Nano手柄，这款XBOX手柄体积更小，价格也更低。

paragraphs.en: The Xbox Nano controller is essentially just a smaller Xbox Series X controller , and while Microsoft's blog doesn't share exact measurements, it is "about 5 inches" long and weighs 3.5 ounces, which is much smaller and lighter than the existing Xbox controller. The Nano Controller is also more affordable, coming in at $49.99, rather than the $69.99 that Microsoft typically charges for a controller.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX Nano手柄本质上就是缩小版的XBOX Series X手柄。微软没有在博客中公布精确尺寸，只表示它长「约5英寸」（约12.7厘米），重3.5盎司（约99克），比现有XBOX手柄小巧、轻便得多。Nano手柄的价格也更亲民，售价为49.99美元(约合人民币335元)，低于微软手柄通常69.99美元(约合人民币469元)的定价。

paragraphs.en: But while the Nano controller will be compatible with Xbox consoles, the focus here is on other devices like smart TVs, laptops, and any other device that, until recently, Microsoft would have claimed to be an Xbox. To that end, Microsoft is teaming up with Samsung to bundle the new Xbox Nano controller, along with two months of Game Pass with "select Samsung TVs" over the holiday season.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然Nano手柄兼容XBOX主机，但它主打的是智能电视、笔记本电脑等其他设备——直到不久前，微软还会宣称这些设备也都是XBOX。为此，微软正与三星合作，计划在假日季购买「指定型号三星电视」的套餐中，附送新款XBOX Nano手柄和两个月的XBOX Game Pass订阅。

paragraphs.en: According to Microsoft's blog , the company is also working on a deal with Meta to include the Nano Controller, along with a Game Pass subscription to new Meta Quest owners, but it doesn't sound like that deal is quite set in stone. Still, Microsoft is targeting a holiday release for that, too.
paragraphs.cn: 据微软博客介绍，微软还在与Meta洽谈合作，计划向新购入Meta Quest的用户提供Nano手柄和XBOX Game Pass订阅，但听起来这项合作尚未最终敲定。不过，微软同样希望在假日季推出这项套餐。

paragraphs.en: Of course, the compatibility will stretch even further than just Samsung TVs and Meta Quest. Becuase the controller has both the standard Xbox wireless connection, along with Bluetooth, the Nano Controller should work with pretty much any device that supports Bluetooth. So, you could use this to play Fortnite on your iPad, if you're so inclined.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，Nano手柄兼容的设备远不止三星电视和Meta Quest。它既支持标准的XBOX无线连接，也支持蓝牙，因此应该能用于几乎所有支持蓝牙的设备。所以，如果你愿意，也可以用它在iPad上玩《堡垒之夜》。

paragraphs.en: But while the Xbox Nano controller is Microsoft's first foray into mini controllers, it's far from an original concept. Companies like CRKD and 8BitDo have been selling mini controllers for years, and the selling point is the portability. With a controller this small, it's incredibly easy to slip it into a bag and take it wherever you go, without taking up too much space or adding a lot of heft to your bag.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管XBOX Nano手柄是微软首次涉足迷你手柄领域，但这个概念远非微软首创。CRKD和8BitDo等公司销售迷你手柄已有多年，主打的就是便携性。这么小的手柄随手就能放进包里，走到哪儿带到哪儿，既不太占空间，也不会给包增加太多重量。

paragraphs.en: This isn't the only thing that Microsoft's controller team has been working on. For months, there have been leaks suggesting that the new Xbox Elite Series 3 controller is right around the corner , and might even fix some of its predecessor's compatibility problems.
paragraphs.cn: 微软手柄团队在做的还不止这些。几个月来，不断有泄露消息称，新款XBOX Elite Series 3手柄即将推出，甚至可能解决上一代产品的部分兼容性问题。

paragraphs.en: The Xbox Nano Controller will be available starting in November, and you can preorder it now. But as for the partnerships with Samsung and Meta, we'll likely just have to wait until those companies announce more details as the holiday season approaches.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX Nano手柄将于11月发售，目前已开放预购。至于微软与三星、Meta的合作，我们可能还得等假日季临近，由这些公司公布更多细节。
